svg.title: Gate and conductance responses under a voltage clamp
svg.desc: Voltage is externally held at −20 mV; the voltage ODE is not evolved. Gates start at the original model resting state and follow the exact constant-rate solution. Sodium conductance rises then falls while potassium opens more slowly. This is a synthetic neuronal model, not a cardiac-cell calibration.
